style: Vivid 3D animal black comedy, dry slapstick; saturated cobalt and tangerine, crisp contrast, no haze
subject: Old grey goose; COBALT-BLUE vest over chest and back throughout, glasses on cord, orange feet
second_characters: Mole in YELLOW jacket and orange hardhat at rim
props: ONE whole shovel held by mole; ONE teaspoon owned by goose, except final flight. No other tools.
environment: SUNLIT tangerine clay pit 1.5 goose-heights deep; turquoise sky. Bright light reaches floor all 10s.
lighting: Warm amber key on both faces, cyan rim from left and coral rim from right all 10s; cobalt vest and yellow jacket distinct from orange clay, no flat grey wash
motion_rule: Camera physically moves in sharp 0.3-0.8s bursts from frame zero; at least three readable moving close-ups, strong parallax. Full-bleed vertical frame even during rotations.

audio.delivery: Goose alone, dry proud elderly voice; beak unobstructed throughout speech, lip-sync when visible; silent after 7.4s

timeline.a: Mole ALREADY dumps a shovel-load of orange clay onto goose's freshly cut step. Goose jerks his teaspoon clear as the step collapses.
timeline.c: Camera ALREADY flies full speed from outside over rim, past foreground shovel blade, into the clod striking the spoon by 0.45s. Strong parallax, tight moving close-up; no wide intro.

timeline.a: Goose cuts another step with the teaspoon, climbs it, cobalt vest visible. Mole braces his whole shovel above.
timeline.c: Camera whips low from spoon to goose's speaking face, then arcs up to mole's shovel; moving close-up on goose.

timeline.a: Goose cuts a third step. Mole scoops a huge load of clay, still gripping the whole shovel.
timeline.c: Camera swings overhead past goose's blue vest to the heaped orange shovel in foreground; sharp changing perspective.

timeline.a: Mole tips clay onto both steps; they vanish. Goose drops onto sunlit pit floor, teaspoon safe in right wing.
timeline.c: Camera tumbles with clod, then rushes into a moving close-up of goose's face and orange impact.

timeline.a: Goose brushes a few orange flecks off blue vest and defiantly raises tiny spoon. Mole kneels and lowers the whole shovel toward it.
timeline.c: Camera flies up from pit floor past blue vest to mole's paws, then dives down the shovel shaft.

timeline.a: Shovel blade touches goose's teaspoon: tiny ding. Mole keeps shovel; goose keeps spoon, speaking beak clear. Goose spreads wings.
timeline.c: Camera orbits from mole's paws along whole shovel to blade against spoon, moving close-up of their ridiculous size difference.

timeline.a: Goose flings spoon upward, then suddenly FLIES out of pit, blue vest bright against turquoise sky.
timeline.c: Camera shoots upward beside goose, passes his wing and rolls above rim without exposing black edges.

timeline.a: Mole lays flat shovel blade on goose's head: soft cartoon BONG. Goose sinks straight back into pit, glasses crooked; mole holds whole shovel.
timeline.c: Camera hurls at contact for a close-up, then drops with goose, preserving his yellow-coated opponent above.

timeline.a: Same teaspoon falls from sky and sticks in clay before goose's beak. He picks it up and starts the SAME tiny step again; mole waits above with shovel.
timeline.c: Camera dives after spoon to tight moving close-up of beak, spoon and first gouge; vivid orange clay fills frame.

negative_prompt: subtitles, captions, watermark, text overlay, English speech, static camera, slow motion, black borders, extra limbs, duplicate props, extra tools, split shovel, hat on goose, blood, dim pit, muted colors, grey wash
